name: envbook
description: Private developer workspace and encrypted personal vault

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@envbook/shared && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=@envbook/shared && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:unit
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=api && npm run lint --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@envbook/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
